question: There are 38 members in group A, 31 members in group B and 52 members in group C. All the members of these groups went to a restaurant. The average amount spent on each member of group A, B and C is ₹375, ₹309 and ₹298, respectively. The total average amount (in ₹) spent per member is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed combined average be ₹300.

Net deviation = 38 × (375 − 300) + 31 × (309 − 300) + 52 × (298 − 300)

⇒ Net deviation = (38 × 75) + (31 × 9) + (52 × −2) = 2850 + 279 − 104 = +3025

Total members = 38 + 31 + 52 = 121

Final Average = Assumed Average + (Net Deviation ÷ Total Members) = 300 + (3025 ÷ 121) = 300 + 25 = 325.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹325.**
